description: The image shows DBeaver database IDE open with a SQL query editor on the left side containing a complex SQL query that selects table_size, table_name, and time_created fields, with pagination using LIMIT/OFFSET and filters including WHERE clauses. On the right side, there is a terminal/console window displaying execution results showing "Breakdowns:" with PRE queries and POST queries statistics, listing dates (2022-2q22 through 3q23) with counts, and a summary line showing "Total processed this time = 2 PRE + 14 POST = 16 quarters". The user appears to be reviewing query execution results, with the cursor visible in the terminal output area. The Windows taskbar is visible at the bottom showing PostgreSQL/pgAdmin icons.

The screen shows DBeaver (a database management application) with SQL code visible in the editor on the left side, containing queries with SELECT statements referencing table names and columns like `table_size`, `table_name`, and `time_created`. On the right side, there is a dark terminal/output panel displaying execution results with timestamps showing dates like "2022-Jul22-Jul22" and a status message at the bottom reading "Total processed this time: 2 PRE + 14 POST = 16 queries". The user appears to have just executed a batch of SQL queries and is viewing the results, with the Windows taskbar visible at the bottom showing it's running on Windows with PostgreSQL indicated in the system tray.

The screen shows DBeaver (database management application) on the left side with an SQL query editor open, displaying a query that selects "table_size, table_name, table_schema, time_created" from what appears to be a BigQuery metadata table ("pg_size_pretty" and "from all_tables" are visible). On the right side, there's a dark terminal window showing execution output with timestamps in the format "2023-Sep2-0x22" and a summary line at the bottom stating "Total processed this time = 2 PRE + 14 POST = 16 queries". The user appears to be reviewing the results of a database query execution, with the terminal showing processing status of multiple queries across different time periods.

The screenshot shows DBeaver database IDE on the left side with an SQL query editor containing a SELECT statement querying table metadata (table_size, table_name, table_owner fields) with conditions filtering by table_name. On the right side, there's a dark terminal window displaying "Breakdown:" followed by execution statistics showing "PRE queries: 1422 - 2 quarters" and "POST queries: 1422 (through 3y21 (inclusive))" with a summary line "Total processed this time: 2 PRE + 14 POST = 16 queries;" with a blinking cursor visible. The Windows taskbar at the bottom shows the time as 11:48 AM, with DBeaver's icon visible in the taskbar indicating this is a Windows environment running database development work.

The image shows a Windows desktop with DBeaver database IDE open, displaying a SQL query editor on the left side with highlighted code selecting table_size, table_name, and time_created columns, along with commented-out code for analyzing PostgreSQL tables. On the right side, there's a dark terminal/console window showing execution results with a "Breakdown" section listing PRE queries (2 queries) and POST queries (apparently 5x21 through 5x25 inclusive), with a summary line stating "Total processed this time - 2 PRE + 14 POST = 16 queries". The user appears to be reviewing database query execution results, with the cursor positioned in the terminal output area. The Windows taskbar is visible at the bottom showing various application icons including PostgreSQL and file explorer.
